messages:
anna: Heads-up — analytics wants to start the route-quota schema split this week. We need a safe read adapter for Console dashboards before dual-write.
josh: +1. What shape is the new schema? any breaking fields for console queries?
mahesh: New has route_profile_id (uuid) and an optional quota_bucket_id, older has route_id string and a nested quota object. Queries using route_id -> joins will break.
sasha: We can't rewrite all dashboard queries at once. Proposal: add a query-layer shim that accepts both shapes and normalizes to a single projection for the Console.
anna: That sounds reasonable. Perf impact on large dashboards?
mahesh: The shim will add a small mapping step. Biggest risk is when we backfill materialized views — need to ensure we don't spike read latency.
elaine: UX ask: during the rollout we want a flag in the Console to toggle between "old" and "new" metric sources for a tenant so SRE/product can validate visuals.
console-ux: We'll add the toggle but need an event to surface which tenants flipped and when.
josh: Telemetry plan: emit analytics event `quota_schema.toggle` + `quota_schema.fetch_shape` for reads. These will let us correlate errors/latency.
anna: For safety, do dual-write for 48 hours with shadow reads on a small percent before switching reads.
mahesh: Dual-write is fine but need idempotency. The old pipeline sometimes rewrites quota objects with missing fields; new schema requires defaults.
sasha: We can add an ingestion-stage sanitizer in the adapter: if quota_bucket_id missing, set to `null` and set legacy_quota blob.
elaine: Backfills: dashboards rely on materialized_counter tables. We should plan a background backfill that writes to MVv2 and mark a safepoint so queries can hit MVv2 exclusively once done.
josh: Concern: MV backfill will hammer write QPS. Can we rate-limit and parallelize per-tenant window to spread load?
mahesh: Yes — run backfill job with tenant concurrency 50, per-tenant rate 200 writes/sec. Start in canary region first.
anna: Canary cohort: pick 5 low-traffic tenants and enable dual-read+toggle. Monitor errors and p95 latency for 24h.
console-ux: We'll create a small banner in the Console for canary tenants: "Viewing new analytics source (canary)" with link to feedback.
deploy-bot: deploy plan recorded: staging -> canary -> region roll -> global. Will post deploy windows to #release-war-room.
josh: API debate: should we change internal ingest API to accept both variants, or strictly accept new shape and push adapter to translate old writes?
mahesh: Prefer adapter approach — keep ingest API stable for downstream services. Adapter lives in eng-platform between gateway and analytics service.
sasha: Also add a feature flag `use_route_quota_projection` so we can switch per-service during rollout.
anna: Ops checklist: 1) feature flag = on for canary tenants. 2) enable dual-write for pk/route mappings. 3) start backfill for MVv2. 4) switch Console toggle to default new for canary. 5) observe 24h.
elaine: Add a short telemetry dashboard (progress, per-tenant errors, MV backfill percent, read latency). Product needs that before canary.
josh: I'll add `telemetry:quota_schema.backfill_pct`, `telemetry:quota_schema.read_errors`, `telemetry:quota_schema.read_latency_p95`.
mahesh: One more: DB compatibility — make sure any new UNIQUE constraints are deferred until backfill completes. We had a deadlock last time when constraints dropped.
sasha: Good call. We'll create migration that adds columns nullable, populate them, then in a maintenance window flip constraints.
anna: Who owns docs? We need runbook for rollback and a feature flag playbook.
elaine: I'll draft the runbook and a short FAQ for support.
josh: Ok, timeline: staging tests tomorrow, canary start Thu 06:00 PST, region roll Mon. I'll update release notes.
mahesh: I'll implement adapter + sanitizer PR today, targeting code freeze EOD.
sasha: I'll own backfill orchestration and the migration DDL with constraint gating.
anna: Thanks everyone — if no blockers, let's proceed. Ping here when staging passes.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy window at 2026-03-26T06:00:00Z to region us-west-2 (owners: josh, mahesh, sasha).
